understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate each level’s grid to step onto and activate every goal cell. A goal cell only completes when the carried piece matches that goal’s required shape, color, and rotation at the same time. Completing all goals in the level advances to the next level; finishing all levels wins the game. Avoid running out of lives, which happens after depleting stamina too many times.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you choose a movement action (north/south/east/west). Movement can be blocked by walls, leaving your position unchanged but still costing stamina. Every action consumes stamina; when stamina reaches zero and you take another action, you lose a life and stamina resets. Stepping on modifier tiles changes the carried piece: shape modifiers cycle the shape, color modifiers cycle the color, and rotation modifiers rotate the piece 90° clockwise. To complete a goal, you must adjust your piece via these modifier tiles until its shape/color/rotation exactly match the goal, then move onto the goal cell to activate it.
